title: Amberfall — Continuing the story where the original ending left off! 🍂
author: Gold-Maintenance-548
selftext:
Hey everyone!

Ever since finishing the original ending of *Snoot Game*, I couldn't stop thinking about what comes next for Anon and Fang. The story felt like it deserved a true continuation—not just a footnote, but a full chapter exploring their future, the challenges ahead, and the warmth of a new season.

That’s why I’ve been working on **Amberfall**.

This is a passionate fan-project built to serve as a direct continuation of the original ending. We are pouring our hearts into the writing, the atmosphere, and capturing that exact emotional weight that made the original game unforgettable.

The autumn leaves are falling, the campus is quiet, but the journey isn't over yet.

What are your expectations for their future? Drop your thoughts below, and stay tuned—we’ve got a lot more to show you very soon! 🍂✨
